echo_blast.title: Echo Blast
echo_blast.concept: In Echo Blast, players control a spaceship that must navigate through a futuristic track while avoiding obstacles and collecting power-ups. The twist: the player's ship leaves a sonic blast trail that attracts or repels other ships on the track, creating a dynamic and unpredictable racing experience.

burst_blitz.title: Burst Blitz
burst_blitz.concept: In Burst Blitz, players control a high-speed car that must navigate through a futuristic city, collecting power-ups and dodging obstacles while racing against the clock.

echoes_of_neon.title: Echoes of Neon
echoes_of_neon.concept: In Echoes of Neon, players control a futuristic, neon-lit runner who must navigate through a series of increasingly challenging levels filled with obstacles and power-ups. By collecting and combining different neon fragments, players can unlock new abilities and enhance their runner's speed and agility.

skyball.title: Skyball
skyball.concept: In Skyball, players control a ball that can bounce and roll through a futuristic city, collecting power-ups and avoiding obstacles while trying to reach the exit before time runs out. The twist? The ball can transform into a variety of objects, each with its own abilities and weaknesses.
